name: How do I create a budget for an investment property renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I create a budget for an investment property renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by getting detailed estimates from contractors for each aspect of the renovation. Research material costs and consider the condition of existing structures to anticipate potential issues. Allocate a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of the total budget, for unexpected expenses that may arise during the project. Prioritize essential repairs and high-impact upgrades. Track all expenditures closely to stay within your budget. A realistic budget accounts for both planned costs and unforeseen challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a renovation budget by getting detailed contractor estimates, researching material costs, and including a 10-20% contingency fund for unexpected expenses.
